segments.label: Premium gifting options
segments.criteria: Source-matched products have premium/luxury wording in the catalogue copy and a listed price of at least ₹1,500. Price-only products in the top 10% of their category are review candidates. Neither rule is an independent quality certification.

segments.label: Employee recognition
segments.criteria: Source copy explicitly mentions employee recognition, rewards, achievement, or service awards.

segments.label: Retirement and farewell
segments.criteria: Only source text mentioning retirement, farewell, long service, or send-off is a direct match. Product-type suggestions without that text remain review-only.

segments.label: Leadership and CEO
segments.criteria: Source copy explicitly references CEO, CXO, leadership, executives, board members, or senior management.

segments.label: Senior client gifting
segments.criteria: Review candidates mention client gifting and are in the top quartile of listed unit prices within their category. The word senior is not present in the source data, so these are not auto-approved.

segments.label: Visiting team welcome
segments.criteria: Direct matches require visitor/visiting-team text. Travel, drinkware, stationery, and onboarding items are separate review candidates only.

segments.label: Milestone moment
segments.criteria: Source copy explicitly mentions milestones, anniversaries, years of service, work anniversaries, or achievements.

segments.label: Festival gifting
segments.criteria: Source copy names a festival/festive gift, or the source taxonomy classifies the item under Festive Hampers.

segments.label: Diwali
segments.criteria: Source text explicitly mentions Diwali or Deepavali.

segments.label: Christmas
segments.criteria: Source text explicitly mentions Christmas or Xmas.

segments.label: New Year
segments.criteria: Source text explicitly mentions a New Year gift.

segments.label: Eid
segments.criteria: Direct matches require Eid, Ramadan, Ramzan, or Iftar wording. Generic non-food candidates are review-only and do not imply halal or religious suitability.

segments.label: Ganesh Chaturthi
segments.criteria: Direct matches require Ganesh Chaturthi, Ganpati, or Ganesh wording. Generic diya/candle/decor candidates are review-only.

segments.label: Employee onboarding
segments.criteria: Source copy explicitly mentions onboarding, new hires/joiners, joining kits, or welcome kits.

segments.label: Workplace recognition
segments.criteria: Direct recognition/reward copy or the authoritative Awards & Trophies catalogue category.

segments.label: Company milestone
segments.criteria: Direct source copy must tie a milestone/anniversary to the company. General milestone products are candidate-review only.

segments.label: Retirement
segments.criteria: Source text specifically mentions retirement. Award, travel, writing, and hamper products are review candidates only.

segments.label: Client appreciation event and conference
segments.criteria: Source copy explicitly mentions client gifting/appreciation or event/conference/delegate gifting. The matched context is retained with each assignment; it does not claim every item fits both contexts.

membershipStatuses.source_match: Direct source text or authoritative source category evidence; still use the evidence fields when reviewing public labels.
membershipStatuses.review_candidate: Inferred from product type, relationship tier, or price proxy; not a confirmed occasion fit.
